title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

synopsis: Seiya Tonami is an office worker in his late twenties. His Friday night routine involves relaxing with a drink, alone at his favorite standing bar. However, he is also a side-character destined to die protecting the protagonists at the end of the very first chapter… Death events are inevitable, and if he abandons the protagonist party to run away, the world will be destroyed and game over! Silva, determined to avoid his doomed fate, begins to use his knowledge of the game in order to complete the game as fast as possible. Will Silva be able to overcome his death event and survive? (Source: Spira, translated)

As he contemplates suicide, he catches sight of an advertisement for Space Force—a military force dedicated to protecting the planet from extraterrestrial threats. Without a moment’s hesitation, he joins the force with a simple plan in mind: he’ll sacrifice himself for his comrades after a suave line and be free. Except…Nao is too good at this job! Although she started her life as a "Master Jewel," she was not able to help people as much as she would like. Then she meets Alecrea, a master jeweler who is rumored to be a "Jewel Killer." He seems to be pursuing the unknown dark side of the jewelry box. In order to get closer to the truth, Yuni helps Alecrea and meets various other jewelry masters. Little does she know that she herself will eventually become the one to change the world. Follow your wishes and uncover the truth of the beautiful jewel box world.
